desc: Designed as a minimalist alternative to large range bags and packs, the Micro Mini Range Bag can transport most micro, sub-compact, and compact pistols, and revolvers with ease. Using five integrated magazine loops, plus pockets for ammunition, small cleaning kit, eye protection and soft foam or electronic inner-ear protection, its diminutive profile is deceptively spacious. May also be used as individual organizers in larger range bags and packs.
